notes.title: Where in the World Are My NPCs?
notes.content:
[p]Just wrapped up adding a world map to the game! It’s done entirely in pixel art, complete with charming little animations and handy NPC markers so you can track folks down—even when they’re off wandering. As you explore, the map dynamically unveils new regions, rewarding curiosity with a broader view of the world.[/p][p][/p][p]This is just a portion of the full map for the demo. More areas are coming soon—including the town, which is currently under [i]extremely enthusiastic[/i] construction by the Gnomes. They keep mentioning needing to go back to Gnome Depot for additional materials, so I'm just going to let them have at it.

[/p][previewyoutube="3Lm63sS8R6c;full"][/previewyoutube][h2] [/h2][p]
[/p][h1]Character Showcase: Bartholomew[/h1][table noborder="1" colwidth=""]
[tr]
[td][p][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43695673/8fbd2834aba18bf099122c1635fb029468be9253.png[/img][/p][/td][td][p]
[list][*][p] [b]Class:[/b] Merchant Guild
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Favorite Dish:[/b] Cinnamon Ginger Caramels
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Description:[/b] Some people are known for their warmth, charity, and welcoming hospitality. Bartholomew isn't. Bartholomew enjoys appearing to be knowledgeable and selectively enforcing propriety. He does cook a mean tart.
[/p][/*][/list][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]
Bartholomew is being voiced by the one and only [url=https://www.joelsteudlermusic.com/]Joel Steudler[/url]. In addition to being an excellent composer (and writing all the music for the game), he's also quite the talented voice artist. Have a listen:
[/p][previewyoutube=n0A3aaKFjnI;leftthumb][/previewyoutube][h2] [/h2][p]

[h1]Follow the Development of Everybody's Stranger[/h1]
I've been posting progress updates on a variety of internet time holes if that's your sort of thing. Pick your poison: [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@tyrillion]TikTok[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/tyrillion/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.youtube.com/@Tyrillion]YouTube[/url].

Also, if you'd like to know when the demo is released, you can [url=http://subscribepage.io/everybodysstranger]sign up for the mailing list[/url].

Love and grumpy innkeepers,

-Rick

notes.title: A Shiny New Toolbar
notes.content:
Greeting listeners! Welcome back to Swamp Things Considered, where we dive into deep topics like "Self-watering crops, is it for real?" "What is up with that cave porcupine?" and in this issue, "Why the tool menu was so hard to use, and how we fixed it."

Throughout development, we've had a handful of dedicated playtesters (so much love to all of you) trying out new features, finding outlandish bugs, and walking through walls, and the number one thing that they all struggled with was the toolbar.  So... I completely redid it with the help of a fancy Unity plugin called the Ultimate Radial Menu. The version in Everybody's Stranger is fully customized with a brand-new skin (which was super easy to do with the help of the developer).

[previewyoutube=yhHA4rGjgm0;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
[h2][/h2]

[h1]Character Showcase: Booker Flimblebottom[/h1]
[table noborder=1]
[tr]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43695673/38c4f9490ce51f13212fe200601da1202438a6b2.png[/img][/td]
[td]
[list]
[*] [b]Class:[/b] Merchant Guild
[*] [b]Favorite Dish:[/b] Cinnamon Ginger Caramels
[*] [b]Description:[/b] A "tax collector" by name only, Booker Flimblebottom is more than happy to share, in exhausting detail, his Inn-Vestment Token [INV] platform, where you can collect tokens to use to upgrade your Inn, and... other things. He's jovial, a lover of strange desserts, and mostly just very happy you set foot in his office.
[*] [b]Voice Actor:[/b] Jason, an aspiring game developer, is taking up the role of Booker.
[/list]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[h1]Don't Be a Lurker[/h1]
If you've been following along with the development of Everybody's Stranger so far, don't be shy and post in the comments!  I'd love to incorporate some of your ideas into the game. Maybe it's a festival, a mysterious relic, something to find in the monocle realm, a quality of life thing you've always wanted to see in games like this one, etc. I'll respond to each and every comment and even put some of your ideas into the game.

Love and mustaches,
Rick

notes.title: Follow these socials to stay up to date with Everybody's Stranger development!
notes.content:
This quick post is for anyone who wants to follow the progress of the game and see updates along the way. Here are a few of the platforms I'll be posting on and the type of content I'll be sharing.

TikTok: [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@tyrillion]https://www.tiktok.com/@tyrillion[/url]

Videos on TikTok will mostly be fun little tidbits of the game, weird bugs I encountered during development, and showcasing new features.

X: [url=https://x.com/ebstrangergame]https://x.com/ebstrangergame[/url]

Screenshots, new NPC art, and announcements will find their way to X.

Mailing List: [url=subscribepage.io/everybodysstranger]subscribepage.io/everybodysstranger[/url]

The mailing list is saved for extra special announcements, like when/where you can sign up for the beta.

And I couldn't leave you without a new character!
